name: cobbleandcandle/timeline
title: Timeline
description: Milestones in your history. One per line: Year | Title | Short text.

items.default:
1888 | The first supper | Lamplighter Josiah Wren opens his parlour to the evening tide.
1931 | The cellar opens | The old coal store becomes a wine cellar of 400 bins.
1998 | Cathedral Close | A second house opens in a former vestry beside the cathedral.
2014 | Chef Margot | Margot Ellery takes the pass and rewrites the bill of fare.
